# soaspec

**Tag**: web, testing

## 简介

Helps to create tests for 'SOAP' or 'REST' apis. Easily represent multiple requests with
the same configuration. Examples designed for RSpec and Cucumber.

## 官网

- 主页: https://gitlab.com/samuel-garratt/soaspec
- 文档: https://www.rubydoc.info/gems/soaspec/0.3.11
- RubyGems: https://rubygems.org/gems/soaspec
